motion.heavy:
Identity-preserving physique variant. Reference1 is a36frame HEADLESS BODY animation atlas (6columns x6rows). Reference2 is the approved HEAVY MUSCULAR physique. REDRAW all36poses from reference1 with reference2's heavy athletic body, while preserving pose order, exact6x6grid, transparent padding, teamuniform colors, clothing details, view directions, held bats, and the described gestures. Same chunky square pixel art and simple material palette.
Heavy body: visibly broad thick CHEST and solid core, thick upperarms and thighs, powerful shoulders, flat athletic abdomen. DO NOT make a spherical body, saggy belly, fat caricature or oversized waist. Distinguish it from broad-shouldered Vbody: heavy has substantial waist and forearms throughout. Short compact athletic limbs asref2; onlyslightly taller body than normal. Never add a head/hair/face/cap. Every frame ends at small neck stub.

row1 frontstand, right3quarterstand, rightprofilestand, rear3quarterstand, backstand, rightlead-off crouch.
row2 rightwalkstrideA, rightwalkpassing, backwalkA, backwalkB, rightrunlongstrideA, rightrunpassingA.
row3 rightrunlongstrideB, rightrunpassingB, backrunA, backrunB, rightdeceleration frontfootplant, rightbase-wait frontfootextended.
row4 rightbatready, loadkneeup, horizontalRIGHT impact, highfollowthrough batUPLEFT behindshoulder, checkedswing halfway, lowerbatpreparerun.

row6 boweddisappointed, lookuphandnearabsentforehead, hitbypitchrecoil, botharmsraisedcelebration, onefistpump, pointRight.
Same scale and anatomy across36frames; groundbaseline within cells constant forgroundedposes. Every bat and allhands/feet fully insidecell. Do not shrink heavybody when crouching orrunning, just bend limbs. Transparentno background/ground/shadow/letters/logos/numbers/gridlines. Big lowres pixel clusters asreference2, avoid fine texture or gradients.
